title: claim, v1
description: A statement plus the evidence it rests on, each piece pinned to the version of the source that was read. Three fields are required; everything that lets a claim be re-checked is optional and the adapter for each shape supplies it. See docs/claims.md.

^x-[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$.description: Adapter-carried data that does not fit the core. Never read by a generic consumer.

id.description: The producer's id for the claim; unique only within that producer.

statement.description: One plain sentence. 600 is the largest limit of the four shapes (the phone-shell fact text).

checked_at.description: When the claim last held against its evidence, by the method in recheck. For a claim never re-checked, when the evidence was read.

confidence.description: The producer's belief in the statement. Not comparable across producers.

valid_from.description: Earliest time the statement is known to hold in the world.

valid_to.description: When it stopped holding; absent means unknown, not forever.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the cited bytes. What it covers is given by scope.

scope.description: slice: the cited line range or fragment, lines joined by LF with no trailing LF. source: the whole document. Absent means slice.

commit.description: The git commit the locator is read at.

observed_at.description: When the source was read. The weakest pin: it says when, not what.

kind.description: What sort of source this is. An open vocabulary: the producer names it, the resolver for that kind reads it. Common: file, url, commit, observation.

locator.description: Where in the source: path:line, path:start-end, a URL, or a URL#json-pointer. Without it the evidence cannot be re-read.

quote.description: A short passage of the source that supports the statement. 300 is the phone-shell limit.

method.description: resolve: every locator still resolves at its pin. hash: and every sha256 pin still matches the cited bytes (at least one evidence item carries one). quote: and the quote is still found in them. support: and a judge still finds the statement supported. metric: re-run the locator, compare the value with expect. manual: a person looks.

max_age.description: How old checked_at may be before a consumer must treat the claim as unchecked. A duration in hours or days (ISO 8601).

tolerance.description: Relative, for a numeric value: 0.1 accepts a change of 10%. Absent means exact.
